description: The URL we POST events to, which types it is subscribed to, and whether it is still switched on. Null when none is set up. Never the signing secret. When we switched it off, `disabledAt` says when and `disabledReason` says why: `failures` when every delivery to it failed for 5 days, `key_inactive` when the API key that saved it stopped working. `savedByKey` is the id of the API key that saved it, or null when a person did. `catchUp` counts what you can send it again: `missed` events from while it was off, and `failed` deliveries. `missed` counts only the event types it is subscribed to now. Each count stops at 1000, which means that many or more. `retentionHours` is how long an event is kept, and `pressMax` is the most one resend call queues. A signed-in owner can call this, or an API key with both setup and read permission.
name: get_webhook
title: Get the webhook endpoint
